items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: He was with us--one of the New York Hotels he was there for a while.

ctx.x: I don't remember too much about Bird in the band. Who knew in those days that you had to pay absolute attention to everything this guy does. Didn't know, just didn't know.
And Oscar Pettiford was on the band for a while?
For a while. He was with us--one of the New York Hotels he was there for a while.
